scope: Four static ordinary vegetation identities. No new spawns, animation, collision or runtime integration claim.

frames.description: Tall branching trunk beneath three broad angular leaf masses; visible roots and open space beside the trunk distinguish solid tree from low passable vegetation.
frames.actualUse: Existing ordinary Tree owns solid physics, destructibility and plant/wood thermal material.
frames.limits: No tree harvest, hidden fruit, new shadow, oversized canopy or cross-cell body. Damage, fire and removal remain simulation state.

frames.description: Dense woven bramble with broad matte leaf clusters and short visible brown stems. Both axes meet at leafy boundaries so a repeated row, column or elbow reads solid.
frames.actualUse: Existing ordinary solid Hedge; one cached frame does not depend on neighbor discovery or allocate adjacency variants.
frames.limits: Boundary exception: leaf contacts touch all four cell edges including row23. Corner notches are one-pixel-scale leaf breaks, never walkable-looking lanes. No berries or invented fence posts.

frames.description: Low broad leafy bush with three small rust-red fruit clusters and a short woody footing; no upright trunk or solid wall silhouette.
frames.actualUse: Actual unspent HarvestablePart yields one to three WildBerries and removes the source on successful gathering.
frames.limits: Fruit marks identify the plant, not an item count. No perpetual spent bush, light halo, extra produce or new obstruction.

frames.description: Sparse dry forked stems and pale snapped tips, with ample open space between branches; warm brown rather than live green leaves.
frames.actualUse: Existing non-solid DryBrush terrain, readily combustible and destructible. Actual thermal/effect state owns ignition and removal.
frames.limits: No permanent flame, green foliage, harvest fruit, new solid collision or out-of-cell twigs.
